title: Smart Data Models - EDINT Commercial Census - CommercialAggregation
description: The integration of several establishments or points of sale in the same physical space, such as a shopping center or a traditional market (edintcom:CommercialAggregation, subclass of edint-infraestructura's Facility). NOTE: the source ontology's own ontology.ttl redeclares 'Facility' (and InfrastructureElement/UrbanElement) under this ontology's OWN censo-locales# namespace, rather than importing/reusing edint-infraestructura's real classes -- almost certainly an artifact of copying a template ontology, not an intentional new class; this candidate treats these subclass relationships as targeting edint-infraestructura's real Facility, not the namespace-duplicate one. See standard-metadata.yaml.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'CommercialAggregation'

dateCreated.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Entity creation timestamp. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification of the entity. This will usually be allocated by the storage platform.

name.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/name'. Name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/alternateName'. An alternative name for this item.

description.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/description'. Description of this item.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

seeAlso.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

identifier.description: Property. A human-readable code identifying the aggregation in the source data (dct:identifier), e.g. 'AGR-0001'.
